open.text: [B] Take the operator lock around each signed step in `#sweep`, `#sweepOpportunistically` and `#control` in `src/fleet/campaign-routes.ts`, not around the whole sweep
[B] Add lease renewal and a holder check immediately before broadcast in `src/fleet/store.ts` and its adapters
[B] Replace `finding_M5` with a two-instance test driving real nonce behaviour
[B] Add the alert sink routing to the existing Telegram bot, with FR-023's three timescales and the named operator chat
[B] Alert on a sweep failure, a refused withdrawal, an unposted charge older than four hours, and the operator's balance reaching half the float

[US1] [F] Add the holders gate in `app/src/fleet/holders-gate.ts`: above the threshold passes silently, below shows holdings and requirement with links to buy CHIT and to the testnet host, a failed read shows retry
[US1] [F] State once, where a depositor reads it, that the gate controls the interface only and the contract accepts direct deposits within its caps
[US1] [F] Read the caps from the deployed pool in `app/src/fleet/balance.ts` and refuse a size that would breach either
[P] [US1] [F] Test the gate's three states, including that a failed balance read shows retry and never rejection
[US2] [F] Choose the launch candidates: CHIT plus at most three memes on 4663, named and recorded before any checking begins
[US2] [F] Add `src/fleet/token-registry.ts` loading and validating the reviewed list per `contracts/token-registry.md`, failing hard when a `poolId` does not match its key
[US2] [F] Create `deployments/token-registry-4663.json` with CHIT's real pool key, its measured bound and its checks
[US2] [F] Wire the fleet buy path in `src/fleet/campaign-routes.ts` to the registry's pool key, replacing the hardcoded venue key
[US2] [F] Quote through the existing `pool-registry.ts` discovery and `market.ts` arithmetic rather than the single full-range formula at `src/fleet/market.ts:118`
[US2] [F] Refuse a buy that would land outside the token's bound, before any transaction is sent
[US2] [F] Show the bound as the least the depositor will receive, as part of the quote they accept
[US2] [F] Add the per-campaign failure counter to `src/fleet/store.ts` and its adapters, counting only gas-spending failures
[US2] [F] Refuse buys on a campaign with three failures in the last hour, telling the depositor why and when it reopens
[US2] [F] Bind the token picker to enabled registry entries only in `app/src/fleet/`
[US2] [F] Make disabling an entry stop new buys without affecting tokens already held, and keep the owner's path to move them
[P] [US2] [F] Replace `finding_M6` with a sibling showing the encoded buy names the real pool
[US2] [F] Fork test on 4663 per listed token: quote and execution agree within the bound
[US2] [F] Check and record each candidate from T062: transfer behaviour, holder restrictions, pool key, liquidity at fifty times the draw cap
[P] [US2] [F] Test that a disabled entry is never offered, no path trades it, and holdings of it remain movable
[US3] [F] Add the refused state to the withdrawal surface in `app/src/fleet/`: what happened, try again, and the exit beside it
[US3] [F] Use the same state for a paused pool, keeping the exit reachable
[P] [US3] [F] Test that a refusal records no charge and the exit remains available
[US4] [F] Create the second Vercel deployment for 46630 with its own environment and the `testnet.chit.tools` domain
[US4] [F] Confirm each host names its chain and neither offers the other's funds
[US4] [B] Point the bot's playground button at the testnet host
[F] The published-promise commit: correct Stage 2's FR-016, `README.md`, `ONBOARDING.md`, the community brief and the landing page, in one commit that says why
[F] In the same pass, carry Stage 2's privacy wording forward verbatim and confirm no surface has strengthened it
[F] Correct the drafted Telegram and X announcements to state holders-only access, per FR-042
[F] State in depositor-facing copy that the caps remain until a professional audit is complete
[F] Confirm no sell path is reachable in the mainnet build, as a test
[F] Soak on testnet for forty-eight hours with alerting on; no charge unrecorded beyond four hours
[F] Rehearse on a fork of 4663: caps read back, refusal without a guardian, guardian pause without the operator, exit while paused
[F] Rehearse each of the three pause triggers on the fork, including the two that fire automatically
[F] Re-measure every listed token's liquidity on the day of launch
[F] Verify contract source on the explorer for every deployed contract
[F] Record the open decision against each acceptance outcome with its evidence, per FR-040
[F] Deploy with a guardian and open the beta
